title: Trace the European cached object copy bank
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI on Wine
changes: Traced both four-byte cached object copies, the two direct initializer callers and both context field producers.
Identified two bounded switch tables with 21 targets and 33 unowned support words for a 216-byte follow-up extraction. The four-byte seed and fill vector already have e348 owners.
validation: Wine m2fn_94l verified 400 disassembled halfwords with 31 input guards and server drain. Source plan fo895xwa matched all 52 support words against e348 and passed 32 guards.
limitations: The 0x0f68 allocation cannot cover a 0x1bd0 clear. Its ability to reach the call, the actual live field writer and the final cached-tail writer require ordinary observations.
Original BIOS, generated execution, native Linux and the USA profile remain deferred. No performance measurements.
